title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch with Integrated Towel Bar, Wall Mount | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add organization and display space to your bathroom with this 16-Inch glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar for everyday convenience.

  • Tempered glass shelf: 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and strength
  • Integrated towel bar: Clever built-in bar keeps hand towels within reach
  • Solid brass hardware: Crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Wall mount design: Wall-mounted installation saves floor space
  • Coordinates easily: Part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place accessories and a cohesive transitional look

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Projection: 5 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch)
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options like fire engine red, unlacquered brass, golden yellow, lavender, and spanish gold.

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, traditional style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Waverly Place Collection, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom décor.
